caption: The drawing depicts a single rooster standing upright, shown in profile facing right. The rooster's body, wings, and tail are all intricately detailed, using fine lines and shading to convey the texture and layering of feathers. Its comb, beak, and wattle are clearly defined, and the eyes are small and round. The tail is prominently arched, with several long, curved feathers extending backward and slightly upward. The rooster stands on two legs, with each foot having three forward-pointing toes and one backward-pointing toe. The entire image is rendered in shades of black, gray, and white, on a light beige or off-white background. The drawing is surrounded by a thin, rectangular border, and the name "H. Blumenstiel" can be seen in the lower left corner. There is a faint scale beneath the rooster, and the paper has some stains or discoloration, especially in the corners.
title: Weather Vane
